question: How often should I wash the filter of my Samsung split AC, and how do I clean it?
raw:
Clean the air filter every two weeks or when the (filter‐cleaning reminder) appears on the indoor unit display [ac_001 p9]. 

To clean the filter, follow these steps:
1. Slide the filter off of the unit [ac_001 p9].
2. Use a soft brush or vacuum cleaner to remove any dust or debris on the filter [ac_001 p9].
3. Soak the filter in a solution of water and mild detergent for 30 minutes [ac_001 p9].
4. Rinse the filter and let it air dry in a well‐ventilated area that is out of direct sunlight [ac_001 p9].
5. Reinstall the filter [ac_001 p9].
6. Reset the filter-cleaning reminder: In operation ▶ ▶ ▶ Select Filter Reset. ▶ [ac_001 p9].

question: My Samsung AC indoor unit smells musty. Does it have a self-cleaning option?
raw: Yes, you can use the Auto clean function if the indoor unit produces odors [ac_001 p8].

question: The outdoor unit of my Daikin FTKS35 is noisy at night. How can I make it quieter?
raw:
To make the outdoor unit quieter at night, you can use the OUTDOOR UNIT QUIET operation, which lowers the noise level of the outdoor unit by changing its frequency and fan speed [ac_002 p19]. 

To cancel or use this feature with a Multi system:
1. Set all indoor units to OUTDOOR UNIT QUIET operation using their remote controllers [ac_002 p29].
2. To clear the operation, clear one of the operating indoor units using its remote controller, though it is recommended to release all rooms using their remote controllers [ac_002 p29]. 
3. Alternatively, if you have a priority room setting, setting the unit in the priority room to QUIET operation will automatically start the OUTDOOR UNIT QUIET operation without needing to set all operated indoor units [ac_002 p30].

Additionally, you can use NIGHT QUIET mode, which reduces the operation noise of the outdoor unit during nighttime hours [ac_002 p29]. Note that NIGHT QUIET mode is available only for COOL operation, requires initial programming during installation by your retailer or dealer, activates automatically when the temperature drops 5°C or more below the highest temperature recorded that day, and slightly reduces the cooling efficiency [ac_002 p29].

question: My Daikin FTKS air conditioner shows code U0. What does it mean?
raw: U0 means refrigerant shortage [ac_002 p40].

question: On my Daikin FTXS L series AC, the breaker trips when I run the AC with other appliances. Is there a low-power mode?
raw: Yes, there is a function called ECONO operation [ac_004 p20]. ECONO operation is a function that enables efficient operation by limiting the maximum power consumption value, which helps ensure that a circuit breaker will not trip when the product runs alongside other appliances [ac_004 p20].

question: My Daikin FTXS L series AC is not cooling well. What should I check?
raw:
If the cooling effect is poor, you should check the following:
1. Are the air filters clean? [ac_004 p38]
2. Is there anything to block the air inlet or the outlet of the indoor and the outdoor units? [ac_004 p38]
3. Is the temperature setting appropriate? [ac_004 p38]
4. Are the windows and doors closed? [ac_004 p38]
5. Are the airflow rate and the airflow direction set appropriately? [ac_004 p38]

Additionally, check that nothing blocks the air inlets and the outlets of the indoor unit and the outdoor unit, and that the drain comes smoothly out of the drain hose during COOL or DRY operation [ac_004 p35].

question: How do I stop mould and bad smell inside my Daikin FTXZ Ururu Sarara AC?
raw:
To reduce the occurrence of mold and odour, it is recommended to dry the inside of the air conditioner by performing the MOLD PROOF operation [ac_003 p28]. 

Here are important details regarding the MOLD PROOF operation:
• It dries the inside of the air conditioner using the FAN ONLY and HEATING operation while performing streamer discharge to reduce mold and odour development, though it does not remove adhered dust and mold [ac_003 p30].
• It is recommended to perform the MOLD PROOF operation on a sunny day to dry the inside well [ac_003 p47]. 
• The HEATING operation will not start if the outdoor temperature is 24°C or higher or if the indoor temperature is higher [ac_003 p30].

question: The orange timer lamp on my Daikin FTXZ indoor unit is blinking. What does it mean?
raw: The TIMER lamp (orange) blinks to indicate that it is time to clean the streamer unit [ac_003 p6, ac_003 p37]. This happens when the total operation time of the air conditioner exceeds 1,800 hours [ac_003 p37].

question: How do I reduce the humidity in my room with the Daikin FTXZ without making it too cold?
raw: You can use the "SARARA" DRY operation [ac_003 p13]. This mode mixes dehumidified cool air with room air to adjust the air outlet temperature and remove moisture [ac_003 p13].

question: Can I set different on and off times for each day of the week on my Daikin FTXS L series AC?
raw: Yes, you can save up to 4 timer settings for each day of the week [ac_004 p23], [ac_004 p2]. The WEEKLY TIMER allows you to set the on/off time and desired temperature according to your family's lifestyle [ac_004 p2]. Up to 4 reservations per day and 28 reservations per week can be set [ac_004 p23].

question: My IFB Senator washing machine shows 'tAP' on the display. What should I do?
raw:
If the display shows 'tAP', check and follow these solutions based on the cause:
1. Ensure that the Water supply tap is turned ON [wm_001 p74].
2. If water supply is unavailable or water pressure is insufficient, operations will restart when the water supply is available or normal [wm_001 p74].
3. If the sieve or filter in the inlet hose is clogged, clean and unclog the sieve or filter by referring to the 'Cleaning the water hose mesh filter' section [wm_001 p74].
4. If the water inlet hose is bent or damaged, remove and replace it [wm_001 p74].

question: Water fills very slowly in my IFB front load washer. How do I clean the inlet hose filter?
raw:
To clean the water hose mesh filter, follow these steps:
1. Turn OFF taps and disconnect the power supply to the machine [wm_001 p60].
2. Unscrew the inlet hose from the machine and tap the drain water from the hose [wm_001 p60].
3. Remove the filter mesh from the tap end of the inlet hose and clean under running water with a brush [wm_001 p60].
4. Pull out the sieve of the magnetic valve with a pair of flat nosed pliers [wm_001 p60].
5. Clean the sieve under running water with a brush [wm_001 p60].
6. Fit the sieve back into the valve [wm_001 p60].
7. Screw the inlet hose back to the machine and the tap [wm_001 p60].
8. Turn ON the water tap to check if the connection is watertight [wm_001 p60].

question: Why won't the door of my IFB washing machine open after the wash?
raw: The door won't open if the water level inside the drum is above the rubber or if the temperature inside the drum is high [wm_001 p30]. Additionally, the door cannot be opened mid-operation due to high water level, temperature, and speed [wm_001 p64]. You can open the door once the wash is complete and the 'End' message appears [wm_001 p30]. The manual does not cover other potential reasons why the door might remain locked after the wash is complete.

untagged: The manual does not cover other potential reasons why the door might remain locked after the wash is complete.

question: My Samsung front load washer is not draining the water. What should I check?
raw:
If your washing machine is not draining, you should check the following:
1. Make sure the drain hose is not frozen or clogged [wm_002 p62].
2. Make sure the drain hose is positioned correctly, depending on the connection type [wm_002 p62].
3. Clean the debris filter as it may be clogged [wm_002 p62].
4. Make sure the drain hose is straightened all the way to the drain system [wm_002 p62].
5. Check if there is a draining problem if a draining error occurs during an operation [wm_002 p10].
6. Make sure the drain hose is not kinked or clogged [wm_002 p60].
7. Ensure the washing machine is supplied with sufficient power, as insufficient power will temporarily prevent it from draining or spinning [wm_002 p60]. 

If the information code remains, contact a customer service centre [wm_002 p62].

question: Can I set my Samsung washing machine so that the wash finishes at a later time?
raw:
Yes, you can set the washing machine to finish your wash automatically at a later time by choosing a delay of between 1 to 24 hours (in 1 hour increments) [wm_002 p43]. 

To use the Delay End function:
1. Select a cycle and change the cycle settings as necessary [wm_002 p43].
2. Tap [wm_002 p43].
3. Turn the Navigation dial to select Delay End, and then tap [wm_002 p43].
4. Turn the Navigation dial to select the desired time, and then tap [wm_002 p43].
5. Tap and hold [wm_002 p43].

question: My LG front load washing machine shows OE. How do I fix it?
raw: To fix the OE error, which is a WATER OUTLET ERROR where the drain hose is kinked or clogged and water does not drain or drains slowly, you need to clean and straighten the drain hose [wm_003 p35].

question: How do I clean the drum of my LG FHM1408 washing machine?
raw:
To clean the drum, you can run the Tub Clean function or the drum cleaning programme once a month (or more often if needed) [wm_003 p32, wm_003 p34]. Follow these steps for the Tub Clean function:

1. Remove any clothing or items from the appliance and close the door [wm_003 p32].
2. Open the dispenser drawer and add anti-limescale powder to the main wash compartment, noting that tablets can be placed directly into the drum as an alternative [wm_003 p32].
3. Close the dispenser drawer slowly [wm_003 p32].
4. Turn on the power, and then press the Time Delay and Pre Wash buttons at the same time for 3 seconds [wm_003 p32].
5. Press the Start/Pause button to start [wm_003 p32].
6. Leave the door open to dry the inside of the appliance completely [wm_003 p32].

question: My Bosch washing machine makes a rattling noise and does not drain. How do I clean the pump?
raw:
To clean the drain pump, follow these steps:

1. Turn off the water tap [wm_004 p34].
2. Switch off the appliance [wm_004 p34].
3. Disconnect the appliance's mains plug from the power supply [wm_004 p34].
4. Open and remove the maintenance flap [wm_004 p34].
5. Ensure the drain pump is empty [wm_004 p36].
6. Carefully remove the pump cap, as water may remain inside [wm_004 p36].
7. Clean the inside and the thread on the pump cap and pump housing [wm_004 p36].
8. Make sure that the impeller in the drain pump can be turned [wm_004 p36].
9. Insert the pump cap and screw it on so that the handle on the pump cap is in a vertical position [wm_004 p36].
10. Insert the maintenance flap, lock it into place, and close it [wm_004 p36].

question: How do I cancel a wash programme midway on my Bosch WAJ20180ZA and open the door?
raw:
To cancel a programme once it has started:
1. Press Start / Reload [wm_004 p30]. 
2. Open the door [wm_004 p30]. 

The appliance door remains locked for safety reasons if the temperature and water levels are high [wm_004 p30]. If the temperature is high, start the Rinse programme [wm_004 p30]. If the water level is high, start the Spin or Drain programme [wm_004 p30]. 

3. Remove the laundry [wm_004 p30].

question: The water pressure is low in my Bosch washing machine. How do I clean the water inlet filter?
raw:
To clean the filter in the water inlet, follow these steps:

1. Ensure the water inlet hose is empty [wm_004 p38].
2. Disconnect the hose from the rear of the appliance [wm_004 p38].
3. Use pliers to remove the filter [wm_004 p38].
4. Clean the filter with a small brush [wm_004 p38].
5. Reinsert the filter [wm_004 p38].
6. Connect the hose and check for leaks [wm_004 p38]. 

You can also clean the filter at the tap by removing the water inlet hose from the tap and cleaning the filter with a small brush [wm_004 p37].

question: What fridge temperature range can I set on my Samsung RF9000 refrigerator?
raw: You can set the fridge temperature from 1 to 7 °C [rf_001 p42].

question: Water comes out very slowly from the dispenser of my Samsung French door fridge. Why?
raw: The water pressure is too low [rf_001 p84]. Make sure the water pressure is between 206-861 kPa [rf_001 p84].

question: My Samsung refrigerator makes clicking and bubbling sounds. Is that normal?
raw:
Yes, those sounds are normal [rf_001 p88, rf_001 p89]. 

When starting or ending an operation, the refrigerator may make sounds similar to a car engine igniting, which can sound like a click [rf_001 p88]. Additionally, as the refrigerator cools or freezes, refrigerant gas moves through sealed pipes and causes bubbling sounds [rf_001 p89].

question: How do I change the fridge temperature on my Bosch KGN fridge-freezer?
raw: To change the refrigerator compartment temperature, press the required temperature [rf_002 p15]. The temperature can be set from 2 °C to 8 °C [rf_002 p17].

question: I am putting a lot of fresh food in my Bosch KGN freezer. Should I switch on a special mode first?
raw:
Yes, you should switch on manual Super freezing before placing a larger quantity of food in the appliance [rf_002 p16]. To switch on manual Super freezing, follow this step:
1. Press super freeze [rf_002 p16].

question: Which foods can I freeze in my Bosch KGN freezer, and how should I prepare vegetables?
raw:
Food that is suitable for freezing includes baked items, fish and seafood, meat, game, poultry, eggs without shells, cheese, butter and quark, ready meals and leftovers [rf_002 p19]. You can also freeze fresh and undamaged food in portions [rf_002 p19]. 

To prepare vegetables for freezing:
1. Wash them [rf_002 p19].
2. Chop them up [rf_002 p19].
3. Blanch them before freezing [rf_002 p19].

question: I am going away for a long trip. Does my Bosch KGN56 fridge have an energy-saving mode for that?
raw: Yes, if you are going to be away for a long time, you can switch on the energy-saving holiday mode on the appliance [rf_004 p18]. The manual does not cover whether holiday mode and energy-saving mode ("eco mode") are the same function or how to activate holiday mode specifically.

question: My Bosch KGN56 freezer does not reach the set temperature and has ice build-up. What can I do?
raw:
To fix the issue where the freezer compartment door was open for a long time and the evaporator in the noFrost system is heavily iced up, follow these steps [rf_004 p26]:

1. Store the frozen food well insulated in a cool place [rf_004 p26].
2. Switch off the appliance [rf_004 p26].
3. Disconnect the appliance from the mains by unplugging it or switching off the circuit breaker in the fuse box [rf_004 p26].
4. Move the appliance away from the wall [rf_004 p26].
5. Leave the appliance door open (after approximately 20 minutes, condensation will start running into the evaporation pan at the rear) [rf_004 p26].
6. To prevent the evaporation pan from overflowing, mop up the condensation water with a sponge [rf_004 p27]. 
7. Clean the interior of the appliance [rf_004 p27].
8. Switch the appliance back on [rf_004 p27].

question: My Bosch KGN56 fridge makes rattling noises. What can cause this?
raw:
Causes for the appliance making noises can be:
1. The appliance is not level [rf_004 p27].
2. The appliance is not free-standing [rf_004 p27].
3. Fittings wobble or stick [rf_004 p27].
4. Bottles or containers are touching [rf_004 p28].
5. Super freezing is switched on [rf_004 p28]. 
Additionally, noises like humming, bubbling, buzzing, gargling, clicking or crackling are not a fault and can be caused by a running motor (e.g., refrigerating unit, fan), refrigerant flowing through the pipes, the motor, switches or solenoid valves switching on or off, or automatic defrosting running [rf_004 p27].

question: How should I dispose of my old Whirlpool NEO refrigerator?
raw:
To dispose of your Whirlpool NEO refrigerator correctly, follow these guidelines:

1. Hand over the appliance to the authorized collection center for the recycling of electrical and electronic equipment waste generated at the end of the product's life [rf_003 p8].
2. Ensure disposal is carried out in accordance with local environmental regulations for e-waste disposal, which mandate channelization to authorized collection centers, registered dismantlers, recyclers, or through pick-up and take-back services provided by the manufacturer [rf_003 p8].
3. For more detailed information about treatment, recovery, disposal, and recycling, call @ 60008558* (for private subscribers, remember to prefix your city STD code) or 18601804558 (for BSNL & MTNL subscribers) [rf_003 p8].

question: How do I steam clean the inside of my IFB 30BRC2 microwave?
raw:
To steam clean the inside of your microwave, follow these steps:
1. Place a microwave container with 200ml water into the oven [mw_001 p38].
2. Press STEAM CLEAN/ DEODORIZE/DISINFECT pad once [mw_001 p38].
3. Press START/EXPRESS COOK pad [mw_001 p38].
4. After the program ends, move the microwave container and glass tray away, and use a soft and dry cloth to clean the oven cavity and door [mw_001 p38, mw_001 p39].

question: I want to preheat my IFB convection microwave to 170 degrees and then bake a cake. How do I do that?
raw:
To preheat and cook with convection (supposing you want to preheat at 170°C and then cook for 35 minutes):
1. Press CONVECTION pad repeatedly until the displayer shows 170C and . [mw_001 p13]
2. Press START/EXPRESS COOK pad [mw_001 p13]. Beeps will be sounded when the designated temperature is reached [mw_001 p13].
3. Open the door and place container of food at the center of the turntable [mw_001 p13].
4. Press number pads to enter cooking time [mw_001 p13].
5. Press START/EXPRESS COOK pad to confirm [mw_001 p13]. 

Alternatively, using CONVECTION+TURN GRILL:
1. Press CONVECTION+TURN GRILL pad repeatedly until the displayer shows 170C、、 and [mw_001 p14].
2. Press START/EXPRESS COOK pad [mw_001 p14]. Beeps will be sounded when the designated temperature is reached [mw_001 p14].
3. Open the door and place container of food at the center of the turntable [mw_001 p14].
4. Press number pads to enter cooking time [mw_001 p14].
5. Press START/EXPRESS COOK pad to confirm [mw_001 p14].

question: My IFB microwave smells of fish. Can I remove the smell?
raw: Yes, you can remove odors from your oven by combining a cup of water with the juice and skin of one lemon in a deep microwaveable bowl, and microwaving for 5 minutes [mw_001 p40]. After microwaving, wipe thoroughly and dry with a soft cloth [mw_001 p40].

question: How do I lock the buttons of my Samsung MC28H5025 microwave so my kids cannot use it?
raw:
To lock the buttons so that children cannot operate the oven accidentally, use the child lock feature by following these steps:

1. Press the Up and Down button at the same time for one second [mw_002 p44].
2. The oven will be locked (no functions can be selected) and the display will show “L” [mw_002 p44].

question: The clock is not showing on my Samsung microwave display. Why?
raw: The time is not displayed because power is not supplied, or the Eco (power-saving) function is set [mw_002 p58]. Make sure power is supplied, or turn off the Eco function [mw_002 p58].

question: My LG microwave does not start at all. What could be wrong?
raw:
The microwave oven may not start for the following reasons:
1. A fuse in your home may be blown or the circuit breaker tripped [mw_003 p226].
2. The appliance is connected to a GFCI (Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter) outlet, and the outlet's circuit breaker has tripped [mw_003 p226].
3. The power cord is unplugged [mw_003 p225].
4. The door is open [mw_003 p225].
5. Cooking time is not set [mw_003 p225].

question: Can I make ghee in my LG MC2846 microwave?
raw:
Yes, you can make ghee in your microwave [mw_003 p199]. Here is how to do it:
1. Put all the malai in a big vessel and blend with a hand mixer till it solidifies into butter and separates from residual liquid [mw_003 p198].
2. Wash this white butter in cold water a couple of times to remove any remaining smell of milk [mw_003 p198].
3. Collect all the butter in a Microwave safe glass bowl and keep in the microwave, select menu, and press start [mw_003 p199].
4. When beeps, stir it properly with a spoon (not plastic) and again press start [mw_003 p199].
5. After beeps, allow it to stand for 5 minutes and then strain it through a stainless steel strainer into a glass jar and store it [mw_003 p199].

question: How do I turn off the child lock on my LG microwave?
raw:
To cancel the Child Lock, follow these steps:
1. Press STOP [mw_003 p20].
2. Hold STOP until an L disappears in the display (approximately 3 seconds) [mw_003 p20].

question: What should I be careful about when defrosting meat with bones in my Panasonic NN-ST64 microwave?
raw: When defrosting meat with bones, care must be taken because meat with bones is lighter than boneless meat of the same weight [mw_004 p20]. You should subtract 500 g for 2000 g of meat with bones, or subtract 250 g when defrosting meat with bones weighing less than 2000 g [mw_004 p20]. Additionally, bones conduct heat and cause the meat next to them to heat more quickly [mw_004 p35].

question: When I use my Panasonic microwave, my Wi-Fi and TV get interference. Is the oven faulty?
raw: No, this does not indicate a problem with your oven [mw_004 p30]. Some radio, TV, Wi-Fi, cordless telephone, baby monitor, Bluetooth or other wireless equipment interference might occur when you cook with the microwave oven [mw_004 p30].

question: How do I update the firmware of my D-Link DIR-825 router with a file I downloaded?
raw:
To update the firmware of the router locally using a downloaded file, follow these steps:
1. Download a new version of the firmware from www.dlinkmea.com [rt_001 p205].
2. Click the CHOOSE FILE button in the Local Update section on the System / Firmware Update page to locate the new firmware file [rt_001 p205].
3. Click the UPDATE FIRMWARE button [rt_001 p205].
4. Wait until the router is rebooted (about one and a half or two minutes) [rt_001 p205].
5. Log into the web-based interface using the login (admin) and the current password [rt_001 p205].

question: I want a separate Wi-Fi network for visitors on my D-Link DIR-825 that cannot see my home devices. How?
raw:
You can create a separate guest Wi-Fi network that allows access to the Internet while isolating devices from the router's LAN [rt_001 p6]. During the initial configuration, you can configure it using the Initial Configuration Wizard [rt_001 p60]:
1. Deselect the Open network checkbox and fill in the Password field if you want to create a password [rt_001 p60].
2. Select the Enable shaping checkbox and fill in the Shaping field if you want to limit the bandwidth [rt_001 p60].
3. Click the NEXT button to continue [rt_001 p60]. 

Additionally, you can isolate devices on the additional network from the router's LAN resources by moving the switch to the right in the Basic Settings > Enable guest network section [rt_001 p118].

question: How can I back up the settings of my D-Link router before I reset it?
raw:
To back up the configuration of your D-Link router:
1. Go to the Configuration > Backup section [rt_001 p203].
2. Click the button to save the configuration (all settings of the router) to your PC, which will be stored in your web browser's download location [rt_001 p203]. 

Alternatively, if you are using the Wizard, you can save a text file with parameters set by the Wizard by clicking the SAVE CONFIGURATION FILE button and following the appearing dialog box [rt_001 p63].

question: I forgot the admin password of my Netgear R6350. How do I reset it to factory settings?
raw:
To reset the router to factory default settings, you can use either the Reset button on the back of the router or the Erase function [rt_002 p141]. 

To erase the settings using the Erase function:
1. Launch a web browser from a computer or mobile device that is connected to the router network [rt_002 p142].
2. Enter http://www.routerlogin.net [rt_002 p142].
3. Enter the router admin user name and password [rt_002 p142].
4. Select ADVANCED > Administration > Backup Settings [rt_002 p142].
5. Click the Erase button [rt_002 p142].

question: How can I block some websites for my kids on my Netgear R6350 router?
raw:
To block websites using keywords and domains on your Netgear R6350 router, follow these steps:

1. Select ADVANCED > Security > Block Sites [rt_002 p79].
2. Specify a keyword blocking option (Per Schedule or Always) [rt_002 p79].
3. In the Type keyword or domain name here field, enter a keyword or domain [rt_002 p79].
4. Click the Add Keyword button [rt_002 p79].
5. Click the Apply button to save your settings [rt_002 p79].

*(Note: The provided sources do not cover how to configure other parental control features beyond this keyword and domain blocking method.)*

question: I want to host a game server at home behind my Netgear router. How do I open a port for it?
raw:
To forward incoming traffic for a default service or application such as a game server, follow these steps:
1. Decide which type of service, application, or game you want to provide [rt_002 p178].
2. Find the local IP address of the computer on your network that will provide the service [rt_002 p178].
3. Launch a web browser from a computer or mobile device connected to the router network [rt_002 p178].
4. Enter http://www.routerlogin.net and log in using the user name `admin` and your password [rt_002 p178].
5. Select ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > Port Forwarding / Port Triggering [rt_002 p178].
6. Make sure that the Port Forwarding radio button is selected [rt_002 p178].
7. From the Service Name menu, select the service or application [rt_002 p178].

If you are using a custom service or application, follow these steps instead:
1. Find out which port number or range of numbers the service or application uses [rt_002 p179].
2. Launch a web browser and enter http://www.routerlogin.net, then log in with your user name and password [rt_002 p179].
3. Select ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > Port Forwarding / Port Triggering [rt_002 p179].
4. Make sure that the Port Forwarding radio button is selected [rt_002 p179].
5. Click the Add Custom Service button and specify the new rule [rt_002 p179].

question: I forgot the Wi-Fi password of my TP-Link Archer C6. How can I find it?
raw:
The default wireless password is printed on the label of the router [rt_003 p83]. If the password has been altered, you can follow these steps:
1. Connect your computer to the router using an Ethernet cable [rt_003 p83].
2. Visit http://tplinkwifi.net, and log in with your TP-Link ID or the password you set for the router [rt_003 p83].
3. Go to Wireless to retrieve or reset your wireless password [rt_003 p83].

question: How long do I hold the reset button on my TP-Link Archer C6 to restore factory settings?
raw: You need to press and hold the RESET button for more than 5 seconds to reset the router to its factory default settings [rt_003 p10].

question: How do I factory reset my Tenda AC10 router with the button?
raw:
To reset the router using the reset button:
When the SYS LED indicator blinks, hold down the button for about 8 seconds, and then release it when all the LED indicators light up [rt_004 p133]. The router is restored to factory settings [rt_004 p133].

question: Can I block YouTube and Instagram on my daughter's phone at certain times with my Tenda AC10?
raw:
Yes, you can configure parental control rules to block YouTube and Instagram for your daughter's smartphone [rt_004 p75] [rt_004 p76]. 

Procedure:
1. Log in to the web UI [rt_004 p75].
2. Click Parental Control [rt_004 p75].
3. Find the device to which the rule applies and click , or click +New if the device is not online [rt_004 p75].
4. Set parental control rules as required and click Save [rt_004 p75].
5. Configure the parental control function for the daughter’s smartphone following Step 3 to Step 4 [rt_004 p76].
